main_text.p: Hæc est generalis libertatis renuntiatio: cuius rationem claris similitudinibus illustratam subiungit Paulus nimirum certiorem & clariorem propriæ salutis operationem: nam quo diligentius in aliorum salutem procurandam incumbit eò suam certiorem & infirmiorem facit verf. 23.24.25.26.27.
23 Hoc autem facio propter euangelium vt particeps illius fiam.
24 Nescitis quod in stadio currentes omnes quidem currunt, vnus autem palmam accipit: sic currite vt comprehendatis.
25 Omnis autem certans omnia continens est: illi quidem vt corruptibilem coronam accipiant, nos autem incorruptam.
26 Ego igitur sic curro vt non incertum, sic pugillor, vt non aerem verberans.
27 Sed obtundo corpus meum, & in seruitutem redigo, ne quo modo aliis prædicans ipse reprobus fiam.

page.notes: Page is a single text column. The "Verf.1" line at the lower right is a marginal/catchline-type note; the scan is light and some words (e.g. "certiorem", "vt", "pugillor") are as printed. Some letters in the body are faint; "pugillor" and "reprobus" are printed as shown.
